subject: Vendor portal onboarding & evidence cadence — Palisade Analytics
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@palisade.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@palisade.io
Date: 2026-06-29T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr/Whistic onboarding for Palisade — next steps?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement at Palisade would like to get our security profile established in Vendr and upload CAIQ/SIG artifacts into Whistic (we have a SOC 2 report and a few supporting docs). Can Redwood support both portals, or do you prefer we centralize on one vendor portal?

High-level ask:
- Confirm which vendor portal(s) Redwood prefers for evidence ingestion (Vendr vs OneTrust vs Whistic).
- Typical cadence for evidence refresh and TTL expectations.
- Any requirements for S3 proof-of-possession artifacts or signed attestations.

We have the SOC 2 PDF (2025 attestation) and a list of encryption/KSN docs ready. I can share an initial inventory spreadsheet. Can we aim for a kickoff next week?

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Vendor Ops | Palisade Analytics
attachments: palisade_evidence_inventory.csv (csv)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@palisade.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-29T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Whistic onboarding for Palisade — next steps?

Hi Aisha — great to hear from you and thanks for the inventory. Redwood can onboard to Vendr and Whistic; for most customers we surface a primary profile in Vendr (catalog + purchase path) and mirror evidence into Whistic for downstream buyers where requested.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Quick intake call to finalize scope and portal targets (30m).
2) We map the inventory to SIG/CAIQ/OneTrust fields and flag any missing artifacts.
3) Upload SOC2 and signed proofs into Vendr; we provide an S3 manifest for proof-of-possession if you need programmatic verification.
4) Define evidence rotation cadence (we typically recommend annual SOC2 + quarterly config snapshots for critical controls).

I attached a short onboarding checklist to help structure the kickoff. If that looks good, can you share availability next Tue/Wed morning PT?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: palisade_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@palisade.io>
Date: 2026-06-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Whistic onboarding for Palisade — next steps?

Quick follow-up items for the kickoff:
- If Palisade wants S3 proof-of-possession, we need the bucket ARN(s) and a time-window for object signing (we prefer a short-lived manifest signed by Palisade).
- For SOC2 artifact redaction: do you want full reports or redacted versions? Our standard is full report for signed buyers, redacted for public portal entries.
- Requesting the name and email of the technical contact who will accept portal invites (Vendr account owner + Whistic admin).

I'll prepare the upload plan and role matrix ahead of kickoff.

Kimberly Park
Security Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@palisade.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@palisade.io
Date: 2026-06-30T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Whistic onboarding for Palisade — next steps?

Marissa / Kimberly — thanks, this looks good.

Answers:
- We can provide an S3 manifest and policy; bucket ARN is arn:aws:s3:::palisade-evidence-prod. We prefer the manifest approach and are fine with short-lived signatures.
- We'll share a redacted SOC2 for public posting and the full signed attestation for buyers under NDA (we can upload both).
- Technical contact: Jorge Mendez <jorge.m@palisade.io> (please invite him as Vendr owner and Whistic admin).

Availability for kickoff: Wed Jul 1, 10:00 AM PT works for our team. I can also share the inventory XLS and a copy of our redacted SOC2 ahead of time.

Aisha
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@palisade.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Jorge Mendez <jorge.m@palisade.io>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Whistic onboarding for Palisade — kickoff confirmed + MAP

Thanks Aisha — Wed Jul 1, 10:00 AM PT is in my calendar. I invited Jorge and Ben; meeting invite includes a short pre-read.

Attached: Palisade mutual action plan + the SIG questionnaire we'll use as the upload template. During the call we'll:
- Confirm portal targets (primary: Vendr; mirror: Whistic).
- Map inventory rows to SIG/CAIQ fields and prioritize any missing controls.
- Agree on evidence TTL and who will be responsible for rotation (we suggest Palisade SOC2 annual; Redwood will surface reminders and can host a signed manifest if requested).

Action items for kickoff (pre-call):
- Aisha: upload redacted SOC2 and inventory XLS to the Drive link; share S3 manifest sample.
- Jorge: accept Vendr & Whistic invites and confirm admin permissions.
- Kimberly/Ben: prepare upload access + role matrix and an initial upload window (we estimate 2–4 hours of net work for initial ingestion).

Attachments: Palisade_MAP_v1.docx (docx), SIG_questionnaire_v3.pdf (pdf)

Looking forward — speak Wed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
